title: Queens That Can Attack the King
summary: On an 8x8 chessboard, given the positions of multiple black queens and the position of a white king, identify and list the coordinates of the black queens that can directly attack the king.
statement: On an 8x8 chessboard, given the positions of multiple black queens and the position of a white king, identify and list the coordinates of the black queens that can directly attack the king. The output can be in any order.
constraints: All pieces occupy distinct squares on an eight-by-eight board.
A queen attacks along a row, column, or diagonal unless another queen blocks it.
Return the nearest attacking queen in each direction; output order does not matter.
hints: Treat the king as the origin of eight direction vectors.
Walk each ray outward until leaving the board or meeting its first queen.
Record that queen and stop the ray.
A farther queen is blocked by the first occupied square, so the eight scans return exactly all attackers.
editorial: A farther queen is blocked by the first occupied square, so the eight scans return exactly all attackers.

tests.explanation: The nearest visible queens are at zero-one, one-zero, and three-three.
Only the first queen encountered along each of the eight rays can attack.
